help.title: Help
help.frameColorsText: Every value carries the colour of the frame it comes from; the frame name is always shown as text. The colours are defined in config/frame-colors.json.
help.notRelevant: Grey: not relevant for the timetable
help.notRelevantText: These elements are shown in grey including their content; the frame name stays visible. Content with the same name elsewhere keeps its colour. The list is in config/not-relevant-elements.json.
help.checksText: Checks against a draft guide are labelled “checked against draft <commit>”, never “valid”.
help.guideText: The explorer reads the guide clone netexRealisationGuideSwitzerland (branch next). The guide status box shows the version and reports when it differs from the last tested one or the XSD is missing.
checkStatus.not_implemented: not implemented yet (planned for the first release)
check.xml_syntax.title: XML syntax
check.xml_syntax.description: Checks whether the file is well-formed XML; errors are shown with line and column.
check.references.title: References
check.references.description: Checks whether every reference (…Ref) points to an object of the expected type: resolved, unresolved, ambiguous or in a file that is not loaded. If a reference names a different version than its only target, it stays resolved and gets a note.
check.xsd.title: XSD validation
check.xsd.description: Validates the file against the NeTEx XSD of the guide version.
check.general_rules.title: General guide rules
check.general_rules.description: The four general Schematron rules of the guide.
check.ch_core_rules.title: Swiss core rules for the timetable
check.ch_core_rules.description: About 20 rules from the guide templates: mandatory elements, forbidden elements and allowed values.
check.ch_profile_rules.title: Other Swiss profile rules
check.ch_profile_rules.description: The remaining roughly 330 rules from the guide templates, later via the build tool of the guide.
feature.guide_status.title: Guide status
feature.guide_status.description: Shows at the top left the guide version in use (branch, commit), whether the XSD is present, whether this version has been tested and whether the mapping table is readable, each with a hint on what to do.
feature.frame_legend.title: Colour legend
feature.frame_legend.description: Always shows which colour belongs to which frame. Grey means “not relevant for the timetable”.
feature.language_switch.title: Language switch
feature.language_switch.description: User interface in German or English. Values, codes and texts from the files are never translated.
feature.help_page.title: Help page
feature.help_page.description: This page: features, colours, checks performed and not performed, and severities, generated from the current settings.

feature.example_selection.description: All examples of the guide version, each loadable on its own, with status: ✔ no messages, ℹ/⚠ with notes or errors, ✖ not readable, “changed since last test” or “new”.
feature.journey_list.title: Journey list
feature.journey_list.description: Journeys of the file with train number, line, departure and first and last stop; each value leads to its location in the file. Anything that cannot be resolved is marked as such.
feature.object_search.title: Object search
feature.object_search.description: Simple search by object type and partial text in ID or name, page by page.
feature.object_detail.title: Object details
feature.object_detail.description: Type, ID, frame with colour, file with line and column, path and content of an object; values unchanged from the file.
feature.xml_view.title: XML view
feature.xml_view.description: Excerpt of the file with exact highlighting of the selected value and coloured frame areas in the margin.
feature.diagnostics_list.title: Diagnostics
feature.diagnostics_list.description: Problems in the file with severity, category and location; a click shows the location in the XML.
reference.unresolved: {element}: target {ref} (expected: {expected}) not found although the dataset contains objects of this type.
reference.external_or_unloaded: {element}: target {ref} (expected: {expected}) is not in this file (external or not loaded).
reference.version_differs: {element}: target {ref} has version {found}, the reference names version {version}. The reference counts as resolved because only one object has this ID.

refs.truncated: References truncated: too many to display.
chain.title: Provenance
chain.empty: Select an item to see where it comes from.
feature.references.title: References
feature.references.description: Shows for each object what it refers to and what refers to it, with the colour of the target frame and the status: resolved, unresolved, ambiguous, or external / not loaded. A reference with a different version gets a note. References inside Extensions are included. Quay and ScheduledStopPoint with the same ID are told apart.
feature.provenance_chain.title: Provenance chain
feature.provenance_chain.description: Shows as coloured boxes where an item sits: frame, containing objects, the item itself and, for a reference, its target. Each box is clickable and marks the place in the XML.
feature.navigation_history.title: History
feature.navigation_history.description: "Back in history" and "Forward in history" revisit objects and items already viewed.
projection.time.departure_missing: Time not computable: the journey has no DepartureTime.
projection.time.departure_invalid: Time not computable: DepartureTime “{value}” is not a time of day in the format hh:mm:ss (local time without time zone).
projection.time.day_offset_invalid: Time not computable: DepartureDayOffset “{value}” is not a whole number.
projection.time.demand_missing: Time not computable: the journey names no TimeDemandType (TimeDemandTypeRef is missing).
projection.time.demand_unresolved: Time not computable: the TimeDemandType {ref} is not resolved in this file.
projection.time.timing_link_unresolved: Time not computable: the OnwardTimingLinkRef {ref} is not resolved.
projection.time.timing_link_not_found: Time not computable: no TimingLink from {from} to {to} found (no OnwardTimingLinkRef, and none matches via FromPointRef/ToPointRef).
projection.time.timing_link_ambiguous: Time not computable: several TimingLinks from {from} to {to} have a RunTime; the choice is not unambiguous.
projection.time.run_time_missing: Time not computable: the TimeDemandType has no JourneyRunTime with RunTime for the TimingLink {link}.
projection.time.run_time_ambiguous: Time not computable: the TimeDemandType has several JourneyRunTime for the TimingLink {link}.
projection.time.wait_time_ambiguous: Time not computable: there are several JourneyWaitTime for stop {position}.
projection.time.duration_invalid: Time not computable: “{value}” is not a supported duration (e.g. PT10M expected; months and years are not a fixed duration).
projection.time.stop_unavailable: Time not computable: the scheduled stop point of stop {position} cannot be resolved; the TimingLink cannot be determined.
projection.timing_link_from_to: For {legs} legs the OnwardTimingLinkRef is missing; the TimingLink was determined via FromPointRef/ToPointRef (e.g. {link}).
projection.day_offset_default: DepartureDayOffset is missing; 0 applies as default value.
projection.stop_order_differs: The attribute order of the StopPointInJourneyPattern (not allowed) differs from the XML order. The XML order applies.
projection.part_time_differs: JourneyPart {part}: {field} {stated} (day {statedDay}) differs from the calculated time {computed} (day {computedDay}).
projection.dst_night_forward: Night of the time change on {date} (02:00 jumps to 03:00): the journey touches this hour. Times are local time without zone, so the duration is not unambiguous in this night. Nothing is corrected.
projection.dst_night_back: Night of the time change on {date} (03:00 goes back to 02:00): the journey touches the hour that occurs twice. Times are local time without zone, so the duration is not unambiguous in this night. Nothing is corrected.
projection.availability_element_missing: Operating days: the AvailabilityCondition has no {element}.
projection.availability_date_invalid: Operating days: {element} “{value}” is not a date.
projection.availability_range_invalid: Operating days: ToDate is before FromDate.
projection.availability_bits_invalid: Operating days: ValidDayBits may only consist of 0 and 1.
projection.availability_bits_length: Operating days: ValidDayBits has {bits} bits, the period {days} days. The days are not listed because assigning bits to days would be a guess.
projection.notice_unassigned: {count} notice assignments (NoticeAssignment) at frame level name neither this journey nor its journey pattern; they are not shown here.

view.title: View
feature.journey_view.title: Journey view
feature.journey_view.description: Shows a journey (ServiceJourney) as a timetable: a header with train number, line, means of transport, product category and operating days, below it a table with stop, boarding/alighting, arrival, departure and offers. The middle can be switched between “Journey” and “Object”. Every item carries the colour of its frame; a click marks the place in the XML and shows the provenance chain. What is missing or cannot be resolved is marked as such.
feature.calculated_times.title: Calculated times and calculation chain
feature.calculated_times.description: Arrival and departure at the stops are calculated from DepartureTime, RunTime and WaitTime and marked “calculated”. A click shows the calculation chain: every summand with its own clickable source; default values (e.g. a missing wait time) are marked as such. If a summand is missing or not unambiguous, “not computable” appears with the reason, and likewise for all following times.
feature.midnight.title: Day change and time change
feature.midnight.description: Every time shows its offset to the operating day (“+1”, “−1”): explicit (DepartureDayOffset), as default value 0, or calculated by adding up. Times of journey parts (JourneyPart) are compared with the calculated ones; contradictions are warnings. Journeys in nights of the time change get a notice; nothing is corrected.
feature.operating_days.title: Operating days
feature.operating_days.description: Shows the validity period, the number of days and a collapsible list of the days from the AvailabilityCondition (ValidDayBits). There are no statements like “Mon to Fri”. If the length of the bits does not match the period, the days are not listed and a warning appears.
feature.offers.title: Offers and journey parts
feature.offers.description: Shows the offers (ServiceFacilitySet) of the whole journey and of single journey parts (JourneyPart) only, every code unchanged, with its meaning from the mapping table. The journey parts appear with times, operating days and their assignment to the stops; the offers of a part are shown at the stops it includes.
feature.notices.title: Notices
feature.notices.description: Shows the notices (NoticeAssignment, Notice) of a journey: texts unchanged in all languages, plus scope (journey, journey pattern, stop, or section from stop to stop). Notice assignments without assignment to a journey are not shown; their number appears as a notice.
feature.master_data.title: Master data
feature.master_data.description: Codes always appear unchanged. A meaning comes only from the file itself or from the guide’s mapping table, with sheet, row and guide version; otherwise “no explanation in the master data” is shown. Transport mode codes have no explanation.
check.journey_projection.title: Plausibility of the journey view
check.journey_projection.description: When a journey is opened, checks whether the times can be calculated, whether the times of the journey parts match the calculated ones, whether ValidDayBits match the period of the AvailabilityCondition, and whether the attribute order contradicts the XML order. Findings appear as diagnostics of the kind “Journey view”, only in the journey view of that journey.
